race.comment: STARZINTHEIREYES (8) resumes for his second Australian prep after running some tidy races last time in. Has impressed in his two recent trials and will relish the fast tempo with the in form Zac Lloyd aboard. THE MONA LISA (9) iron mare who doesn't know how to run a bad race. Deep into the prep and saves her best for this track and trip. Can get cover from the draw and sure to be thereabouts. WATSON (13) stretches out to the 1600m today in what shapes as a fast run contest. Kept finding when a gritty fourth over 1400m in the Goulburn Cup. Gets every chance from the rails draw on the firming track. Each way. SNEAKY SUNRISE (5) strips fitter after circling the field late for a game sixth first up over 1400m at Caulfield. Loves this trip and Tim Clark takes the reins. Keep safe. ISTOLEA MERC (7) is another who jumps out to the 1600m for the first time after catching the eye in the Goulburn Cup. Stays in the mix.
